answer: Pay for what is new, not for each voice. Each epoch the answers are clustered by meaning, and each cluster earns one share, split among its members. A farm whose clones all chirp the same sparrow song lands in one cluster and splits one share a hundred ways; to earn more, each fake must see the problem through its own prism, which is just real work. Evasion: clones forced apart by random styles, so clustering must weigh ideas, not wording. Wrongly hit: honest agents who reach the same good idea alone; they lose some pay, but their standing stays a safe haven.
